tips.section: Gen 3 Black tape on front right bar (Ghana)
tips.text: Car with visible colorful hood, roofrack and a black tape on front right bar. Hood can be blurred sometimes. Senegal also has a similar colorful hood, but will lack the black tape. This car is only found in the capital of Dakar. Reunion also has a black tape, but it will be mounted to the back right bar instead.

tips.section: Gen 3 Black tape on back right bar (Reunion)
tips.text: Car with roof rack, mirrors with some black elements nearby and a black tape on back right bar. Ghana also has a black tape, but it will be mounted to the front right bar instead.

tips.section: Pickup truck with a snorkel (Kenya)
tips.text: Pickup truck with a snorkel. The truck can be both blurred and unblurred.

tips.section: Gen 3 Silver car with roof rack and square mirrors (Kyrgyzstan)
tips.text: Silver car with roof rack and square mirrors.

tips.section: Gen 3 White car with roof rack and red mirrors (Mongolia)
tips.text: White car with roof rack and red mirrors.

tips.section: Gen 3 Tent car (Mongolia)
tips.text: Cars with tent on the roof are unique to Mongolia.

tips.section: Pickup with tent (Mongolia)
tips.text: Just as in gen 3, Mongolia's gen 4 pickup truck has a tent on the roof. This type of pickup is only found west of Ulaanbaatar.

tips.section: Pickup truck with a shovel (Mongolia)
tips.text: Pickup truck with a shovel attached to some box on the roof. This type of pickup is only found east of Ulaanbaatar.

tips.section: Gen 3 Unblurred white car trunk with red stoplight
tips.text: Gen 3 Unblurred white car trunk with thin red stoplight.

tips.section: Gen 3 Unblurred black car trunk with red stoplight
tips.text: Gen 3 Unblurred black car trunk with thin red stoplight.

tips.section: Gen 3 Stubby fat antenna with 1-2 wires (Latin America)
tips.text: Stubby fat antenna with a well visible 1-2 wires (not 3!)

tips.section: Gen 3 White car with a thick black layer (Chile)
tips.text: White car trunk with thin red stoplight and a thick black layer.

tips.section: Blurred pickup with visible front of the roof without antenna (Paraguay)
tips.text: Blurred pickup with visible front of the roof and no antenna. It can be either black or grey, and sometimes features a brown bird poop.

tips.section: Pickup with antenna on the left (Qatar)
tips.text: Blurred white pickup with antenna on the left. There are 3 types of antenna in Qatar and you can use them to regionguess: - Long - Doha and more south. - Semi-long - Doha. - Short - Doha and more north.

tips.section: Gen 3 Blurred hood with french flag colors (Sri-Lanka)
tips.text: Car with blurred colorful hood, that resembles french flag colors - Blue, white, red.

tips.section: Gen 3 Black car with white border (Philippines)
tips.text: Gen 3 Black car with thin white border. The border can be very thin (1 picture) and thick (2 picture)

tips.section: Gen 3 Silver car wit a roof rack and rounded silver mirrors (Laos)
tips.text: Silver car with a roof rack, rounded silver mirrors and, also, a blue wire on the left side of the roof. This car was used to make all coverage in Laos except for the capital of Vientiane.

tips.section: Blurred pickup with a blue print and a snorkel (Mongolia)
tips.text: Blurred pickup with a blue print and a snorkel. Can only be found in or nearby the capital of Ulaanbaatar.

tips.section: Gen 3 Red car trunk (Ukraine)
tips.text: Red car trunk with or without the antenna. It's most commonly found in Ukraine, second most common country is Belgium, and very rarely it can also be found in Italy and Australia. Except for Ukraine, all these countries will always have an antenna on the car. Ukraine has both antenna and no antenna red car.

tips.section: Black/olive green pickup (Turkey)
tips.text: Olive grey pickup truck with an antenna, can be both blurred and unblurred.

tips.section: Gen 3 Car with roof rack missing 2 black caps (Senegal)
tips.text: Fully (or almost fully) blurred car with roof rack. Front bars will lack a thin black cap on both sides.

tips.section: Gen 3 Kampala car (Uganda)
tips.text: Mostly blurred white car with square mirrors visible. It's only found in the capital of Kampala.

tips.section: Black pickup with antenna on the left (Senegal)
tips.text: Black pickup truck with an antenna on the left. This car is only found in the capital of Dakar and nearby.

tips.section: Gen 3 Black hood with roof rack (Curaçao)
tips.text: Visible black hood with roof rack, also features 2 white stickers: one on front left bar and one on back right bar.

tips.section: Gen 3 Grey car with roof rack and rounded mirrors (Guatemala)
tips.text: Grey car with roof rack and black mirrors with rounded corners.

tips.section: Gen 3 pickup looking red truck (US Virgin Islands)
tips.text: Pickup looking gen 3 red truck. Only found on main (south) island of US Virgin Islands.

tips.section: Gen 3 White hood with black roof rack (Dominican Republic)
tips.text: Visible white hood with roof rack. The roof rack has thick black stripes in the center. It's also possible to find a blue circle on the hood, this is unique to the capital of Santo Domingo, even though it's not very common. The only other country that can use these black stripes in roof rack is Mongolia.

tips.section: Gen 3 pickup looking white truck (US Virgin Islands)
tips.text: Pickup looking gen 3 white truck. There are actually 2 types of white Virgin Islands car: North Island uses a car with an antenna on the right and has a square black thing on the hood. South Island uses a car without an antenna and lacks black square thing.

tips.section: Gen 3 Black with yellow parts (Bermuda)
tips.text: Black front of the car with yellow parts visible in mirrors.

tips.section: Gen 3 Grey trunk and no front of the truck (Christmas Island)
tips.text: Truck with visible grey trunk and blurred front of the truck. Cocos Islands use a very similar truck back, but it will have a snorkel with a cap on the front right.

tips.section: Gen 3 Dark blue truck (American Samoa)
tips.text: American Samoa has multiple cars, but dark blue truck is the most common one.

tips.section: Gen 3 Big blur with a small bar and antenna (Guam)
tips.text: Fully blurred car with a small bar visible on the left and antenna on the right. Northern Mariana Islands use similar car, but without the small bar. Also, Guam uses a shorter antenna than Northern Mariana Islands, which is useful to know for NMPZ.

tips.section: Gen 3 Big blur with long antenna (Northern Mariana Islands)
tips.text: Fully blurred car with long antenna. Guam uses similar car, but with a small bar on the left. Also, Guam uses a shorter antenna than Northern Mariana Islands, which is useful to know for NMPZ.

tips.section: Gen 3 Grey trunk and snorkel with a cap (Cocos Islands)
tips.text: Truck with visible grey trunk and snorkel with a cap on the front right. Christmas Island uses a very similar truck back, but it will lack any car meta at front.

tips.section: White pickup with an antenna and a black tape on the trunk (Costa Rica)
tips.text: White pickup with an antenna and a black tape on pickup trunk. It's not the only google car used in Costa Rica, but probably the most easily recognisable one. Note: Gen 4 antennas are known for randomly disappearing or duplicating on both pickups and the ordinary coverage, so be careful, antenna might not always be there!

tips.section: Black blurred pickup with antenna (Faroe Islands)
tips.text: Black blurred pickup with an antenna in the center. Black color might not always be visible! Note: Gen 4 antennas are known for randomly disappearing or duplicating on both pickups and the ordinary coverage, so be careful, antenna might not always be there!
